page_title: CHE 1-2 AST | Chelsea v Aston Villa 27/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90+2' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.

90+1' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) fires in a promising strike from the free kick just outside the penalty area. His nice effort flies towards the left post but is denied by Robert Sanchez, who pulls off a glorious save!
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Robert Sanchez (Chelsea). Another situation results in a direct free kick for Aston Villa.
89' A pass from Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) is intercepted by Robert Sanchez and the move breaks down.
89' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
89' Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Aston Villa win a corner.
88' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

88' Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Robert Sanchez is alert and denies him with a nice save. The ball is out of play and Aston Villa manage to earn a corner.
87' The current number of corner kicks is 6:5.
87' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

84' 1 - 2 Goal! Youri Tielemans sent a fine cross from the corner kick. The perfect pass found Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) and his bullet header from around the penalty spot went straight into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:2.
84' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) will deliver the corner kick.
83' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Aston Villa will take a corner.
83' Unai Emery prepares a substitution. Boubacar Kamara is replaced by Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa).
83' Here comes a substitution. Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for Ian Maatsen.
82' Reece James (Chelsea) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

82' Reece James (Chelsea) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. The linesman points to the corner flag, Chelsea are going to take it.
81' Jamie Gittens (Chelsea) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Chelsea will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' A pass from Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) is intercepted by Robert Sanchez and the move breaks down.
79' Emiliano Martinez leaps to intercept the corner kick from Pedro Neto (Chelsea).
78' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card. Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.

78' Estêvão (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Chelsea will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
77' 12:8 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 3:5.
76' Reece James (Chelsea) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted!

75' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) brings his opponent down. Stuart Attwell has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Chelsea earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
73' A decent effort by Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) from a close-range free kick! His attempt flies narrowly over the crossbar.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Estêvão (Chelsea) will replace Cole Palmer.
71' This is a yellow card! Liam Delap (Chelsea) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
71' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
71' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is penalised for holding. Stuart Attwell signals a set piece.
70' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
69' Substitution. Alejandro Garnacho leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jamie Gittens (Chelsea).
69' Wilfredo Caballero decides to make a substitution. Joao Pedro will be replaced by Liam Delap (Chelsea).
69' Substitution. Malo Gusto (Chelsea) has come on for Marc Cucurella.
68' Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
68' The referee awards a corner and Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) goes over to take it.
67' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

66' Robert Sanchez was forced into action to thwart Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a shot to the left post but couldn't beat the keeper. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
63' 1 - 1 GOAL! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) got to the ball in front of the goal and he couldn't miss from there. His strike went in off the right-hand post. The score is 1:1.
63' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the right side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper.

61' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, Robert Sanchez anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
59' Here comes a substitution. John McGinn is given a rest as he is replaced by Amadou Onana (Aston Villa).
59' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) replacing Donyell Malen.
58' It will be a substitution. Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is ready to enter the pitch as Emiliano Buendia walks off.
58' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
57' Reece James (Chelsea) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
57' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) takes a short corner kick.
57' The referee is firm and issues Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) a deserved yellow card.
55' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Good work from Aston Villa as they win a corner.
55' A dangerous attempt from Reece James (Chelsea) was aimed towards the roof of the net, but Emiliano Martinez pulls off a superb save and stops this one.
53' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Reece James (Chelsea).
53' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Alejandro Garnacho, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
52' Robert Sanchez leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Matty Cash (Aston Villa).
51' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
48' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) takes the corner with a short pass.
47' That looked a certain handball by Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!

47' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' John McGinn (Aston Villa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Robert Sanchez, who smothers the ball.
45+1' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) tackles a bit over-zealously and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul. Aston Villa win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' The referee blows his whistle as Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) was too aggressive in his challenge.
42' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Emiliano Martinez.
41' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle after John McGinn (Aston Villa) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.

37' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Reece James delivers a teasing cross from the resulting corner and the ball falls into the space where Joao Pedro (Chelsea) is lurking. His close-range shot goes into the net and it's 1:0.
37' Reece James (Chelsea) prepares to take a corner kick.
34' Reece James (Chelsea) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Emiliano Martinez scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
32' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
31' Total attempts – 6:0. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:0.
30' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) has tested the patience of referee Stuart Attwell and goes into the book for a previous late challenge. Matty Cash (Aston Villa) will miss the next game.
26' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) runs onto a good ball played into the box and hits a first-time screamer towards goal, but a defender somehow gets his body in the way and makes the block.
24' Joao Pedro (Chelsea) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez reacts superbly to deny him.
23' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) sprays a pass out to Morgan Rogers, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
21' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
21' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
20' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
18' Alejandro Garnacho links up with Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea), who fires just wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
16' 74:26 – the latest ball possession ratio.
12' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

11' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle after Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Chelsea win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
11' Some patient build-up play from Chelsea as they look to unlock the defence.
9' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
8' Reece James (Chelsea) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
8' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
6' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
5' Good defending. Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) tries to find Morgan Rogers inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
4' Reece James (Chelsea) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
2' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley well wide of the left post from inside the box.
